W.note: Clean, honest, compact stand-in recipe with a juniper wine sauce, but little mammoth world beyond a one-line nod.

X.note: Thorough bone-in reverse-sear with real permafrost and permit detail, but long with troubleshooting and gamey-fix padding.

Y.note: Show-plate framing with Yakutia horse and reindeer and carved-at-table drama; most mammoth-aware but overlong with scaling tables.

Z.note: Treats extinct meat as legitimate then hedges; ingredients list mammoth steaks and advice is muddled, though lingonberry and braise tips are nice.
